cases.name: tau_provider_boundary_documented
cases.proves: Dogpile's skill contract names Tau, not direct SciLLM, as the model orchestration boundary.
cases.does_not_prove: Actual Dogpile synthesis execution through a Tau provider DAG.

cases.name: legacy_scillm_marked_migration
cases.proves: Existing direct SciLLM code is explicitly labeled as legacy migration work.
cases.does_not_prove: Removal of every legacy direct SciLLM call from implementation.

cases.name: brave_search_channel_documented
cases.proves: Brave is a first-class Dogpile web-search channel with query-budget rules.
cases.does_not_prove: Live Brave API credentials or result relevance.

cases.name: brave_questions_replace_perplexity
cases.proves: Perplexity replacement uses concurrent Brave question fan-out.

cases.name: perplexity_retired_default_off
cases.proves: Perplexity is default-off and the deprecated flag is documented as skip-only.

cases.name: github_uses_brave_discovery
cases.proves: GitHub Search composes Brave and defaults to Brave discovery before relaxed gh search.
cases.does_not_prove: Live GitHub auth or semantic repo ranking.

cases.name: arxiv_channel_documented
cases.proves: ArXiv has a documented Dogpile channel and stage-2 hook.
cases.does_not_prove: Live ArXiv availability or full PDF extraction.

cases.name: youtube_brave_first_discovery
cases.proves: YouTube discovery defaults to Brave-first search with yt-dlp fallback and can extract video IDs from web results.
cases.does_not_prove: Live YouTube search availability, transcript availability, or Whisper quality.

cases.name: youtube_transcript_enrichment_default_off
cases.proves: Transcript enrichment is opt-in and Dogpile transcript fetches request transcript text without legacy enrichment.

cases.name: fetcher_internal_primitive_documented
cases.proves: Fetcher is documented as a deep-fetch primitive after a concrete URL is selected.
cases.does_not_prove: Live fetch quality for every URL.

cases.name: feeds_default_off_and_no_key_packs
cases.proves: Feeds are default-off and Dogpile documents credential requirements.
cases.does_not_prove: Live RSS freshness or parsing for every source.

cases.name: configured_rss_packs_require_no_api_keys
cases.proves: Configured Dogpile RSS pack source definitions contain no API-key/token fields.
cases.does_not_prove: Whether each public feed endpoint is reachable right now.

cases.name: wayback_default_off
cases.proves: Wayback is default-off and documented as an optional archive lane.
cases.does_not_prove: Live Wayback availability for a target URL.

cases.name: readarr_default_off
cases.proves: Readarr is default-off and documented as an optional book/Usenet lane.

cases.name: ingest_website_optional_handoff
cases.proves: Website ingestion is documented as an opt-in post-search handoff.
cases.does_not_prove: Live crawl quality or Memory writes.

cases.name: automatic_synthesis_contract_documented
cases.proves: Dogpile requires synthesized, source-grounded reports instead of raw dumps only.
cases.does_not_prove: Actual synthesis quality for a live query.
